prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original low-magic medieval NPC pixel-art review sheet. THREE ROWS, TWO COLUMNS. Every row has one specific adult twice, front-left three-quarter and rear-right three-quarter, six full figures total, isolated on flat grey with generous spacing and no captions. Top ANLA: expressly ADULT woman apprentice rivet maker, late twenties proposed appearance, short chestnut braid, confident precise hands, muted rust work shirt and dark leather split apron, trousers, boots, small ordinary hinged clasp sample held at waist, unmarked steel stamp tucked in belt. Middle WOLEN: her separate master craftsperson, older man with salt-and-pepper moustache, receding hair, muted tawny sleeves and long soot-brown apron, work boots, small hammer held DOWN, restrained proud expression; do not caricature as evil. Bottom JOTIN: adult female typesetter at a subsidiary printing workshop, dark hair in practical bun, desaturated blue work blouse, ink-stained grey apron, rolled linen sleeves, small type-setting stick held close and plain unprinted leaf tucked at side, thoughtful concerned face. These are three DIFFERENT bodies, never clone faces or imply all riveters identical. Wear and accessories consistent front/back. Proposed designs only, not canonical appearance. No signing, successful agreement, public testimony, apprenticeship exit or job loss depicted. Chunky hard-edge pixel clusters, compact top-down-oblique game sprite proportions, limited muted earthy palette, readable silhouettes, minimal portrait detail. No text, watermark, insignia, magic, modern machinery, gradients, smooth glossy shading or scenery. Review concept only, not exact runtime grid or certified palette.
